reviewedFrom: Standard accrual practice for general (no-project) invoices recognised on invoice; progress billing per docs/books-revenue-recognition.md §4b. Customer receipts debit 1010 Undeposited funds until deposited (the policy document's §4e still says 1000 — reconcile in B16.1). Pending licensed-CPA review (B16.3). Amounts are integer cents.

installments-credit-refund-count-once.derivation: Credit memo reduces income in proportion to the invoice's income lines (60/40 of 10,000) plus the 800 tax; the refund reopens 5,000 of receivable and leaves undeposited funds.

account-rename-preserves-posted-history.derivation: Account codes and types are immutable; a rename must not change any posted amount, code or frozen classification.
